title: The Balmer series of hydrogen
caption: Electrons falling to n = 2 emit the visible Balmer lines: Hα 656.3 nm (red), Hβ 486 nm (blue-green) and Hγ 434 nm (violet); Hδ, from n = 6, is at 410.1 nm. In a quasar Hα arrives at 984 nm, so its redshift is z = 984/656.3 − 1 = 0.5.
alt: Hydrogen energy levels n = 1 to 6 with downward arrows from n = 3, 4 and 5 to n = 2, and a line spectrum of three visible lines.
description: Transitions to n = 1 (Lyman) are ultraviolet; to n = 3 (Paschen) infrared.
